g.text: bbob constrained f38 d10 i1 — what the agent chose, and when
Boundaries: evaluator snapshots of prospective decisions; method changes inside a block stay in that block.
Agent: one fresh run, 2,000/2,000 evaluations; GPT-6 Astra, max reasoning. Baselines: seed means (10 stochastic / 1 deterministic); 2,000-evaluation allowance.
Means include seeds with a feasible incumbent; feasibility counts are reported. Regret ≤ 10⁻¹² is shown at 10⁻¹²; early-stopped baseline incumbents are carried forward.
